questions.q: Where do you find the Data Import Wizard?
questions.explain: It is built into Salesforce Setup, so there is nothing to install.

questions.q: Which of these objects is NOT supported by the Data Import Wizard?
questions.explain: The wizard does not support standard objects such as Opportunities and Cases.

questions.q: What is the maximum number of records the Import Wizard handles in one import?
questions.explain: The Data Import Wizard is limited to 50,000 records at a time, one reason bigger jobs use Data Loader.

questions.q: Which operation can the Import Wizard NOT do?
options: Add new and update existing in one import
questions.explain: The wizard only imports; export and delete need Data Loader or Workbench.

questions.q: What kinds of actions can the Import Wizard perform on records?
options: Add new records, update existing records, or both
questions.explain: It offers add new, update existing, and add new and update existing.
